svg.title: Choosing a transcript replication option
svg.desc: A decision flow with one primary question and one override check. Start by asking whether you already own, or independently need, a Microsoft Fabric capacity. If yes, choose Link to Microsoft Fabric with low-latency sync: about an hour of setup, roughly zero incremental cost, and Microsoft operates it. If no, choose Azure Functions on a timer landing in Azure Storage or Azure SQL: roughly two thousand to ten thousand dollars a year cheaper, but you own it forever. Then apply the override: choose Azure Functions regardless of the first answer if transcripts contain personal data that must be redacted before it lands, if history must outlive the thirty day Dataverse purge, if governance forbids replicating into the managed lake, if change tracking cannot be enabled on the table, or if you need only a narrow slice of agents rather than a full replica.
svg.text: One question decides it. One list of exceptions overrides it.

g.text: Do you already own — or independently need — a Microsoft Fabric capacity?

text.tspan: Microsoft operates it, with a support path
Speed you do not need is free headroom
Lands in Azure Storage or Azure SQL
No capacity required to consume it
You own it, and every failure in it

g.text: Override — choose Functions even when a capacity exists, if any apply

text.tspan: Personal data must be redacted before it lands
History must outlive the 30-day Dataverse purge
You need a few agents, not a full replica
You must fan out to more than one target

g.text: Only in-flight transformation solves the first two. No managed option offers it.
